text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I have decided! Tonight— we go to see the 
most beautiful star in this night sky. 
Come!!

On the way back from our outing 
destination. She suddenly shouted that and 
took off running! Flustered, I chased 
after her—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We have arrived at our destination— Heh, 
if one wishes to gaze upon the stars 
tonight, this is the most fitting place!
choice_data_list: It's just a regular hill, though...?

text_block_list.text: "VIV" has... arrived.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: Oh, were you three meeting up?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No. We just happened to gather here. 
...Because this is a nice quiet spot.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Haa... I need to get moving...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Negative. —Analyzing angles and 
obstacles... After moving... the 
"spectrum" degrades.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That is why... for "communicating" with 
the cosmos, within an 8-meter radius from 
here is... "optimal."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, facing the stars in solitude... is 
it? Not bad. Shall we enjoy a dialogue 
with the stars ourselves?

"...And so, on short notice, our 
stargazing session on the hilltop got 
underway."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Look, the arrogant Queen remains bound to 
her cross... Yet they say she is still 
beautiful, so perhaps the Queen's words 
were not entirely in vain.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How ironic that even speaking the truth 
can become a sin. Pity the chained 
princess as well—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You must be referring to the legend of 
Cassiopeia.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Queen Cassiopeia incurred the wrath of the 
gods and was turned into a constellation 
never permitted to rest or set below the 
horizon... That's how the legend goes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A constellation atoning for its sins in 
this world... forevermore.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Still, she is "not alone." Because 
it's... a "rendezvous."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You mean the constellation Cepheus... 
The husband of Cassiopeia, cast into the 
heavens to atone for her sins beside 
her...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Besides, one cannot say it is entirely 
misfortune. Now is also the time to 
display a brilliance that outshines the 
whole sky.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Look where the Queen points—to the 
brilliantly shining North Star! Truly, 
that light looks the most beautiful of all 
tonight!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"‘The Unsetting Star,’ ‘Beacon of the 
Night Sky,’ ‘Guide of Travelers’... 431 
light-years away... 'Polaris.'"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That light is from 431 years ago. Whether 
it shines in the exact same way at this 
very moment, we cannot know. ...So what of 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Shining brilliantly in the present moment! 
That is precisely what makes it beautiful! 
Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Our conversation paints the night sky in 
even richer hues. It has been a truly 
meaningful evening."

On the way home after parting ways with 
the other two. Having achieved her goal of 
"seeing the most beautiful stars," she 
looked thoroughly satisfied.

Besides... chatting with your friends must 
have been quite stimulating as well.
(*Glint*)

Right then, a shooting star flashed behind 
Tanino Gimlet!
choice_data_list: Hey, what was that just now—!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Don't move.

Along with the sensation of both sides of 
my head being clasped, right in front of 
my nose... was the presence of a person. 
Feeling them almost too close for comfort, 
that was—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Just now—a shooting star was clearly 
reflected in those wide-open eyes of 
yours."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just for a single moment— can you 
understand? That beauty.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't been walking by your side, if 
I hadn't decided to stargaze today, if I 
hadn't met you——

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A fleeting beauty we never would have 
witnessed had even a single piece been 
missing. And that is why...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, your brilliance was unmatched! So 
dazzling even the ruler of the heavens 
would be jealous!!

As she said that, she stared intently into 
my eyes. I was overjoyed that her 
stargazing could come true even here, 
but...
choice_data_list:
Still, if it's the star reflected in my 
eyes, that would be...

Still, if it is a star reflected in my 
eyes, then...

text_block_list.text:
As she said that, she stared intently into 
my eyes. I was overjoyed that her 
stargazing could come true even here, 
but...
choice_data_list:
Still, if it's the star reflected in my 
eyes, that would be...

Still, if it is a star reflected in my 
eyes, then...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer. The lingering 
aftertaste is part of the cocktail's 
flavor... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes... A single streak of light crossed 
here. From the tip of this eyelash, down 
to the corner of the eye. Just like a 
tear—

Even after that, as she basked in the 
lingering afterglow of the shooting star 
reflecting in her eyes... we made our way 
home, feeling the fatigue of the day.

Among all the stars and glittering lights 
that I, as a Trainer, gaze upon... the 
most beautiful one of all is none other 
than the Umamusume in my care.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh? In other words—I'm a first-magnitude 
star?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, don't you dare look away. 
Without so much as blinking— bear witness 
to this fleeting flash of light."
